b: It is threads like this that give the community a bad name in the gaming world. A few loudmouths complaining about issues that do not need to be addressed.

Running into explosive traps is literally carelessness. I know, we have all been there. You rush around a corner, probably seeking revenge on someone. Boom. You are dead.

It also happens randomly; someone cleverly places the traps at their sides. Or that one time I placed a trap directly in an unexpected area on a large map - someone really ran into it.

But - the situation I described above is a rare occurrence. Most of the time, people place them in doorways. And that is perfectly fine. If you don't move carelessly, you will never run into a trap.

You can either:

1) Throw a grenade at it
2) Shoot the trap from a safe distance
3) Wait until a teammate triggers the trap and then revive or heal them
4) Simply go around to the other side.

It does not warrant a reduction in effectiveness in any way. It is a very situational tool; if you reduce its effectiveness, no one will ever use it again. The same way the reduction was excessive with other similar tools (and keep in mind, I never used them much, but still think the reduction was too much).

1.) You can never see your own character's face anyway.

2.) Having to render more detailed or different faces per character adds unnecessary strain to the game's performance.

3.) When I am in a firefight, I want to be able to immediately tell which threat I am facing.

4.) Adding this in would bring absolutely nothing new to the gameplay experience and would waste valuable resources.
